positions.name: OwnedIntelligenceAsRetainedAsset
positions.frame: where does durable value live — in the substrate one merely rents, or in the perspective one owns and keeps?
positions.why: Both expressions enact the same antithesis (owned vs. rented intelligence; commodity substrate vs. kept-asset perspective) in matched, plain-spoken maxim form, drawing on market-pricing framing to locate value in what is retained rather than in the substrate. The conviction gradient (src-2 reads as a flat claim, src-3 as a creed-like principle) and the shared autonomy/self-enhancement value appeal both point the same direction — ownership-as-retention is the good being asserted — so the tension between claim-level and principle-level delivery sits inside one coherent read rather than splitting it.
